title: The Impact of Vertical Integration on Physician Behavior and Healthcare Delivery: Evidence from Gastroenterology Practices
authors: Soroush Saghafian; Lina D. Song; Joseph P. Newhouse; Mary Beth Landrum; John T.-A. Hsu
near_miss_reason: Treatment-intensity regressor rather than a binary indicator: every main patient- and provider-level column (Analysis Patient Regression Main.R mod1-mod15; Analysis Provider Regression Main.R mod1a-mod1g) enters the three-valued integration status ind_integ (0 independent, 1 partially integrated, 2 integrated; Analysis Summary Statistics.R lines 6-8) linearly, and every column adds time-varying patient and county controls (age, sex, race, esrd_ind, ind_dual, ind_ccw, index, ind_rural, unemp, poverty, under_65, prop_gi, hmo_pen, hhi). Staggered physician integration 2009-2015 with physician (prf_npi) and year FE, but the published treatment is multi-valued and can switch back. Synthetic data only.
eligible_reason: No main-text column satisfies every rule. Main regressions: felm(outcome ~ patient/area controls + ind_integ | year + prf_npi), two-way clustered by year and physician, on a patient-claim repeated cross-section assigned to GI physicians; ind_integ takes values 0/1/2 (independent / partially integrated / integrated) and enters linearly, and every column has time-varying controls. Section 7 heterogeneity columns interact ind_integ with place_service or ind_anesth (subgroup-by-treatment). Mediation analysis uses lm with year dummies and no unit FE. The only control-free regression (Analysis Anesthesia Mechanism.R line 72, total_anesth ~ ind_integ | year + prf_npi.y, anesthesiologist FE) restricts to binary pairs of the three treatment levels, but the shipped code applies the {0,1} and {1,2} filters sequentially (leaving no variation), its treatment is inherited from affiliated GIs, and its main-text location cannot be confirmed without article text; it is listed but not counted. The data are synthetic in any case.
design_notes: R (lfe::felm). Medicare 20% FFS claims 2008-2015; treatment from yearly share of GI claims billed in hospital outpatient settings (GI Integration.R); physicians switch in 2009-2015 (yearly newly integrated counts hard-coded in GI Integration.R), and the yearly measure can switch back. Only synthetic_data.csv (387,168 rows, made-up values) is shipped; the logs in logs/ are synthetic-data runs.

screener_notes: Screened from readme.pdf, R code, logs and OpenAlex abstract (no article text). Staggered integration design, but the treatment is three-valued and every main column has time-varying controls; synthetic data only. If the article shows the anesthesiologist-volume regression in the main text with a binary treatment, it would be design-eligible but still excluded for synthetic data.
hand_check_nov4: Not controls-only confirmed: the treatment is a three-valued intensity entered linearly in every column, a violation independent of the controls. Flag false kept; reason text now leads with the treatment-intensity regressor so the classifier reads two violations. Borderline near-miss (multi-valued treatment); kept as flagged by the screener. Package only (no article text).
